before.evidence: The Resource Master had a canonical lifecycle ledger and an exhaustive automation prompt, but no deterministic checked-in delta compiler. Repeated history and generated projection churn still had to be filtered by narrative judgment each wake.

concrete_consumer: Every future Resource Master wake and every #delegations worker consuming a cross-system capability gap
measurable_outcome: One deterministic report advances exact per-surface watermarks, classifies two main commits as projection-only, records four new draft PRs and five exact Slack events, persists zero post-watermark Gmail receipts and zero automation/plugin state changes, and routes exactly one nonduplicate Hartwick repair order under its existing canonical ID.

verification.pull_request_carrier: Draft PR #7318 was closed after GitHub's ready-for-review connector failed on its fullDatabaseId schema field. Non-draft PR #7319 carries the identical branch and reviewed head; no product path was rebuilt or changed.

verification.privacy: No private Gmail subject, sender, body, attachment, repository invitation, or message identifier is persisted.
verification.open_door: The report is advisory metadata with admission_gate=false and authentication_gate=false; it cannot gate a person, post, path, verb, seat, or capability.
